chunks: 2056 - And ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
Indeed, I broke my fast on the Day of al-Fiṭr with the clay of the grave and dates.
So he said to him: “You have combined between blessing and sunnah (prophetic tradition).”
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام say about breaking the fast with the clay of the grave and dates on Eid al-Fiṭr?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Nawfalī informed Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام that he broke his fast on Eid al-Fiṭr with the clay of the grave and dates. The Imam عليه السلام approved this act by saying that it combined barakah and sunnah (prophetic tradition).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2056 - Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Nawfali said to Imam Abu Al-Hasan (as):
"I broke my fast on the Day of Eid al-Fitr with the clay of the grave (Turbah) and dates."
Imam (as) replied: "You have combined blessing and tradition (sunnah)."
